scope: Student-operated TODO2 baseline; two complete UDP tests, not the final anomaly study
receiver_log_notes: The direct receiver's two complete 15-second summaries independently confirm 10.0Mbps and 0/12759 loss in each run. Jitter displays are 0.081ms and 0.056ms, slightly different from client-relayed reports.

Raw receiver log also contains ack-of-last-datagram warnings and a 0.0102-second tail session using the second test's client port. Preserve this evidence; do not count the short tail as a third complete 15-second test. Its cause has not been confirmed by packet capture.
